WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_spending_rate
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
), type_rates AS (
    SELECT type, AVG(average_spending_rate) AS average_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates
    GROUP BY type
)
SELECT type,
       average_spending_rate,
       average_spending_rate / AVG(average_spending_rate) OVER () AS rate_divided_by_simple_mean
FROM type_rates;
